summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K announcing its inclusion in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Index (DJ BIC) for the second consecutive year, as assessed by the S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment. The filing highlights the company's ESG performance in transparency, community relations, human capital, water management, information security, and climate strategy. This is a routine ESG disclosure with no financial terms, transaction details, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics. The report contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. It is purely informational about a sustainability index qualification.
